topic: Earthing or grounding connections, cable terminations, crimped terminals and Its advantages.
syllabus_extract: Earthing or grounding connections, cable terminations, crimped terminals and Its advantages. Aluminum cable connections, Plugs and sockets. Different types of plugs and sockets potting, need for electrical Bonding. Static discharge wicks. Bonding and screening methods. Practical on crimping, bonding screening, earthing & grounding.
specific_objectives: 13.1.2.1 Knowledge of Static converting equipment, Bus bars, cable terminations, Switches.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Practical on crimping, bonding screening, earthing & grounding. Safety precautions: Verify power off, wear PPE, inspect tools. Instructor supervision: Monitor crimp quality, verify continuity, ensure correct torque.
intro_questions: What is the primary purpose of earthing in avionics?
Why are crimped terminals preferred over soldered connections?
What is the function of a static discharge wick?

development.content:
Earthing and grounding connections
Aluminum cable connections
Cable terminations and crimped terminals
Advantages of crimped terminals

Plugs and sockets types
Potting requirements
Need for electrical bonding
Static discharge wicks

Bonding and screening methods
Bus bar connections
Practical crimping exercise
Verification of bonding integrity

summary_questions: Explain the difference between bonding and grounding in an aircraft system.
Describe the procedure for verifying a crimped terminal connection.
Why is potting necessary for certain avionics connectors?
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief note on the specific requirements for aluminum cable connections and how they differ from copper connections, referencing the next lesson on Switches.

pft_rows.syllabus: Switches: - toggle switches, push switches, rocker button switches, rotary switches, micro switches, time s/w, mercury s/w, pressure s/w, thermal s/w, proximity s/w, rheostat and relays. Safeties to be taken while installing switches & relays. Practical switches & relays.
